$comment: Example Claude Code managed settings for the machines of people who use ai-sdlc apps. An admin deploys it as managed-settings.json (Windows: C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json; macOS: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json; Linux: /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json) or through the Claude admin console. Managed settings can't be overridden by project or user settings, so the guard rails hold even if an app's .claude/settings.json is edited. See docs/SETUP.md, 'Managed settings'. Remove this $comment key before deploying.
